projectDescription: An autonomous multi-agent code self-healing pipeline that uses Google Gemini AI to generate test suites, execute them in a secure sandbox, diagnose failures, and patch Python source code automatically.
keyFeatures: Multi-agent architecture with specialized Test Engineer and Healer AI personas powered by Google Gemini
Autonomous pytest suite generation from functional requirements and source code
Iterative self-healing loop: generate tests → run in sandbox → diagnose failures → patch code → re-verify
AST-based dependency graph analysis to extract relevant repository context for healing
GitHub App integration: listens to pull request webhooks and posts audit reports as PR comments
Isolated Python sandbox execution using subprocess with configurable timeout and cleanup
Multi-model LLM tiering with automatic fallback and retry logic for 503/429 errors
Structured Markdown audit reports with per-test-case initial vs. final status tracking
publicApiSurface: POST /api/github/webhook — GitHub webhook receiver for pull_request events
GET / — Root health check returning engine status
run_healing_pipeline(request: HealRequest) -> HealResponse — Core orchestrator for in-memory code healing
run_repo_healing_pipeline(repo_dir, language, failing_file, failing_logs) -> HealResponse — Repository-level healing pipeline
generate_test_suite(target_code, requirements) -> str — Test Engineer agent: generates pytest suite
generate_code_patch(buggy_code, requirements, error_logs) -> str — Healer agent: generates corrected code
call_gemini(prompt, system_instruction, model, max_retries) -> str | None — Async Gemini LLM client with fallback
RepoAnalyzer.extract_relevant_context(repo_dir, failing_file, language, depth) -> dict — AST context extractor
RepoAnalyzer.build_dependency_graph(repo_dir, language) -> dict — Python import graph builder
PythonAdapter.run_tests(workspace, timeout, test_file) -> tuple[bool, str] — Pytest sandbox runner
build_healing_audit_report(**kwargs) -> str — Markdown audit report builder
HealRequest — Pydantic schema: buggy_code, requirements, file_path, language
HealResponse — Pydantic schema: success, iterations_used, final_code, generated_tests, patches, logs, audit_report
format_pr_audit_event(event_type, payload) -> dict — Webhook payload formatter
